description: This file defines a LocationService class that manages location updates, authorization, and significant location change monitoring using CoreLocation framework. It provides asynchronous methods for obtaining current location, starting/stopping location updates, and handling location authorization changes.

classes.name: LocationService
classes.description: A final class managing location updates, authorization, and significant change monitoring, providing async methods for location retrieval and control over location services.

methods.name: ensureAuthorization
methods.description: Ensures the app has the requested location authorization mode (when-in-use or always), requesting authorization if needed.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified parameters, handling timeouts and accuracy.

methods.name: startLocationUpdates
methods.description: Starts continuous location updates with specified accuracy, returning an async stream of CLLocation objects.

methods.name: stopLocationUpdates
methods.description: Stops ongoing location updates and clears the update continuation.

methods.name: startMonitoringSignificantLocationChanges
methods.description: Begins monitoring significant location changes with a callback for each update.
